name: Vij: Vizual'naja novella
source:
Philosopher student Homa Brut has to spend several nights at the coffin of a dead lady in an old church in a distant village. His journey will take place through many locations and with the participation of many interesting and charismatic characters, as well as intimate scenes. Before you will be several decisive choices, on which his success will depend.
Will he be able to overcome his fear, or will he have to face evil spirits?..

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
哲学系学生霍马·布鲁特，必须在偏远村庄的一座古老教堂中，守着一位死去女子的棺木度过数夜。他的旅程将经过许多地点，遇见众多有趣而富有魅力的人物，也会经历亲密场景。你将面临几个决定性的选择，而他的成败，就取决于这些抉择。
他能够战胜恐惧，还是不得不面对邪灵…？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409570/]Steam[/url]]
